21-1/4 Inch Bean Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn RIFBP, 21-1/4" Rough Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

This decorative dummy strap hinge gives old world charm to any home without having to install working hinges. This is especially useful where installing working hinges would be impractical, like on a garage door. The 21-1/4 Inch Bean Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge is surface mounted (screwed to the door) with the included matching finish screws. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the naturally weathered iron. The Acorn Bean Tip Dummy Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available Matching:
12" Bean Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
17-1/4" Bean Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge

features and Specifications for the Rough Iron Bean Tip Dummy Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 21-1/4"
  • Width: 1-9/16"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
